EARLY DESIGN REVIEW
R1 Pheasant Hill, RINA LLC
Recommended Action:
A preliminary proposal to develop a residential condominium project consisting of 30 condominium units or twin homes (15 building structures) on a 3.35-gross acre site located on the east side of Lado de Loma Drive, south of Guajome Street (APNS 179-093-18, 23,30,32, and 34). The site is currently vacant and the project proposes a subdivision to create 30 twin homes and associated site improvements.*3
Staff Report
R2 Vista Palomar, Integral Communities
Recommended Action:
A preliminary proposal to develop a mixed-use development consisting of 195 condominium units and an approximately 100-room hotel on a 17.17-acre site located on the north side of W. San Marcos Boulevard. The site is currently vacant land that has been rough graded to accommodate five industrial parcels. The project proposes 36 two and three story condominium buildings, a four story hotel, parking facilities, open space amenities, pedestrian walkways, and associated site improvements.*3
Staff Report
PUBLIC HEARING ITEMS
P2 PC19-067 -- Downtown Specific Plan Amendment, City of Vista
Recommended Action:
A request to amend the Downtown Specific Plan to include a provision for public art as a condition of new development. This project has been determined to be exempt from review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, Section 15061 because the project has no potential to result in a significant impact to the environment.*3
Staff Report
P3 P16-0123 -- Development Code Amendment, City of Vista
Recommended Action:
A request to amend Chapters 18.02 and 18.06 of the Vista Development Code regarding marijuana-related uses. This project has been determined to be exempt from review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines, Section 15061 because the project has no potential to result in a significant impact to the environment.
